STORE_NAME.LABEL: Store Name

HELP.TITLE: How to get API credentials?
STEPS: 2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API
4. Fill in: Description (e.g., Chatwoot), User, Permissions: Read
5. Copy the generated Consumer Key and Consumer Secret
6. Paste them here in the settings
